title: Luke: A 24-Day Devotional
description: One chapter of Luke each day, with a short theme and reflection questions.

days.title: You are never too weak to make a difference
days.summary: God uses people who feel unqualified, like Mary.
reflectionQuestions: What are your weaknesses?
How might God use them?
What attitude needs to change?

days.title: Obedience isn't always easy
days.summary: Mary and Joseph's inconvenient trip to Bethlehem was part of God's plan.
reflectionQuestions: Have you wanted to quit a calling?
Why is obedience hard?
Where is God asking for uncomfortable obedience now?

days.title: Where your family tree begins matters more than where it ends
days.summary: Belonging to God's family comes through faith in Jesus, not heredity.
reflectionQuestions: How can you rest in being God's child?
Is your name in God's family?

days.title: The most powerful speaker to ever live
days.summary: Jesus' words carry unmatched authority because He is fully God and fully man.
reflectionQuestions: What are the most powerful words you know?
What is your favorite verse?
Have you personally encountered Jesus?

days.title: What it means to be made new
days.summary: The miraculous catch shows new life comes from obeying Jesus' word.
reflectionQuestions: What old way is Jesus breaking in you?
What new thing is He teaching you?
Who holds you accountable?

days.title: Following Jesus doesn't always make friends
days.summary: Rejection for following Jesus is met with His love and eternal reward.
reflectionQuestions: How do you respond when others reject your faith?
Where do you find strength in hard times?
How can you fix your eyes on Jesus?

days.title: What do you think you're entitled to?
days.summary: The centurion humbly knew he didn't deserve Jesus' help.
reflectionQuestions: Where has entitlement crept into your life?
How can you be humble before God?
What blessings exceed what you deserve?

days.title: What do your actions say about who you are?
days.summary: Jesus' family are those who hear God's word and act on it.
reflectionQuestions: How do you hear Jesus most clearly?
Is there sin He's asking you to repent of?
What truth should you put into practice?

days.title: Who do you say Jesus is?
days.summary: Peter confesses Jesus as Messiah—is He central to your life?
reflectionQuestions: Who do you say Jesus is?
Does your life reflect it?
What step can you take today to surrender to Him?

days.title: Busyness can cost you the best part of living
days.summary: Mary sat and listened while Martha worried; Jesus values that better part.
reflectionQuestions: Are you more like Martha or Mary?
Where are you settling for less than Jesus' best?
How can you listen to Him more?

days.title: What Jesus says about how to pray
days.summary: The Lord's Prayer is a model: simple, bold and persistent, like a child to a father.
reflectionQuestions: How would you describe your prayer life?
How can you engage God more meaningfully?
When can you pray today?

days.title: Why you don't have to worry
days.summary: God values us far above birds and flowers, so worry loses its hold.
reflectionQuestions: What are you worried about?
What keeps you from trusting God with your future?
How can you hand that worry to Jesus?

days.title: How to not be fake in your faith
days.summary: Real faith bears fruit; it doesn't just look good.
reflectionQuestions: Where have you seen growth recently?
What change would make you more like Jesus?
What needs pruning?

days.title: Who is in charge of your life?
days.summary: Pharisees' pride vs. Jesus' humility at the dinner—does He have the place of honor in your life?
reflectionQuestions: Is Jesus at the head of your life?
What's hindering your next step?
What should you start or stop doing?

days.title: Where to turn when you feel lost
days.summary: The lost sheep, coin and son show the Father welcomes the lost home.
reflectionQuestions: When did you feel closest to Jesus?
What moved you closer or farther?
What step can you take today?

days.title: How to make investments that last
days.summary: Money is God's; we are stewards called to invest in true riches.
reflectionQuestions: Have you acted more like owner or steward?
How much do you consult God about money?
Where can your money make a difference for God?

days.title: Instead of being quick to blame, be quick to thank
days.summary: Ten men are healed, but only one returns to thank Jesus.
reflectionQuestions: Have you forgotten to thank God for an answered prayer?
What blessings do you take for granted?
What can you thank Jesus for today?

days.title: How to know what you worship
days.summary: The rich ruler's wealth and self-righteousness competed with God.
reflectionQuestions: What is most likely to compete with God for your affection?
Is anything in the way of your worship?

days.title: Jesus wants you as you are
days.summary: Jesus calls Zacchaeus by name and welcomes him as he is.
reflectionQuestions: Have you decided to follow Jesus, and how has it changed you?
If not, what holds you back?

days.title: What will relationships be like in heaven?
days.summary: Our deepest intimacy in heaven will be with God; earth is a temporary home.
reflectionQuestions: How does this affect your view of death?
How can you trust Jesus with what you can't control?
Are you sure of your place in heaven?

days.title: What does Jesus want from me?
days.summary: The widow's offering shows Jesus wants total surrender, not a percentage.
reflectionQuestions: Is any area of your life not fully His?
Is He asking you to give something up?
What step can you take today?

days.title: How to be the greatest
days.summary: Jesus says greatness means serving; pride is the enemy of service.
reflectionQuestions: Where has pride crept in?
Who can you confess it to?
How can you serve someone today?

days.title: Why should I forgive?
days.summary: Jesus forgave from the cross; we extend the forgiveness we've received.
reflectionQuestions: Do you see pain as a reason for a grudge or a chance to share in Christ's suffering?
Who should you forgive today?
What step can you take toward forgiveness?

days.title: Jesus meets us where we are
days.summary: On the road to Emmaus, Jesus reveals Himself to disciples who urge Him to stay.
reflectionQuestions: What are you hoping God will move in?
When did you later see God working in a season He felt absent?
